summary: Enable route experiments feature flag for beta account (Acme AI) + confirm RBAC + region allowlist
content:
Requester: Talia Benson (Release coordination)

Request:
Please enable the Route-level A/B testing ("Route Experiments") feature flag for the Acme AI beta account so CS can run the scheduled beta technical deep dive and validate the Console workflow end-to-end.

Account / Org:
- Customer org: Acme AI
- Console org slug: acme-ai
- Primary Redwood project: prod-default

Requested enablement:
- Enable feature in Console UI and Console APIs for experiments (create/start/stop)
- Confirm RBAC prerequisites: which roles can create/start/stop and who currently has them in the Acme AI org
- Confirm region rollout constraints (beta currently not enabled in all regions)

Business context:
Acme AI is a design partner for Route Experiments. They specifically want to test model variants and compare latency/cost per variant with guardrails.

Notes / Constraints:
- Beta is allowlist-only behind a feature flag (do NOT enable globally)
- We need to ensure the org has at least one user with the correct role before enabling, otherwise CS gets blocked during the session

Acceptance criteria:
1) Feature flag enabled for acme-ai in prod for supported regions.
2) Confirmed at least one user has a role that allows experiment mutations.
3) CS/PM notified with expected behavior and any limitations.

---
Activity / Comments:

2025-02-07 10:12 PT — Talia Benson (Reporter)
Created ticket. Linking to beta prep checklist and support tickets we saw in staging about streaming attribution. Requesting enablement for next week’s beta session.

2025-02-07 10:26 PT — Connor O’Brien (Assignee)
Acknowledged. Will coordinate with RBAC owner + platform flags. Need:
- org identifier confirmation (slug vs org_id)
- target regions (us-east/us-west only for now?)

2025-02-07 10:41 PT — Marissa Cole (Product)
Target regions for beta: us-east + us-west only. Do not enable eu-west yet (propagation lag alert tuning still in progress). Stickiness key guidance will be provided during session.

2025-02-07 11:05 PT — Kaitlyn Nguyen (RBAC/authz)
RBAC confirmation:
- Permission needed for mutations: rollouts.experiments.write (covers create/update/start/stop)
- Read-only dashboards: rollouts.experiments.read
Acme AI org currently has:
- 2 users with Org Admin (includes rollouts.experiments.write)
- 3 users with Developer (read-only)
No changes required.

2025-02-07 11:22 PT — Amara Diallo (API gateway / routing hooks)
Feature flag name in control plane: route_experiments_beta
Console flag key: console.rollouts.route_experiments
Both must be enabled for full workflow.
Region notes: gating is enforced at policy layer; allowlist must include org + region.

2025-02-07 12:03 PT — Connor O’Brien (Assignee)
Enabled allowlist entry for org slug "acme-ai" in prod:
- console.rollouts.route_experiments = ON
- route_experiments_beta = ON
Regions allowed: us-east, us-west

Validation:
- Confirmed Console shows "Experiments" tab under Rollouts when logged in as Org Admin.
- Confirmed create experiment wizard loads and validates traffic split.
- Confirmed API returns 403 when using Developer role for start/stop (expected), 200 with Org Admin.

Operational caveats communicated:
- Results dashboards may lag by aggregation window; initial metrics typically appear within 5–10 minutes.
- Do not attempt to run experiments in eu-west; will show "Not available in region" banner.

2025-02-07 12:10 PT — Dylan Brooks (Engineering, Console & Tooling)
Thanks. Reminder: if customer reports missing variant headers on streaming retries, link to the known issue fix in flight (see SUP-24877). For beta, recommend testing non-streaming first for clean attribution verification.

2025-02-08 09:18 PT — Talia Benson (Reporter)
Confirmed with CS: Acme AI can see the Experiments UI in prod in us-east. Marking ticket resolved.

Resolution:
Feature flags enabled for Acme AI (acme-ai) in prod for us-east/us-west. RBAC verified (Org Admin present with write permissions). Region constraints communicated (eu-west not enabled for beta).

Follow-ups:
- None for this ticket. If Acme requests eu-west enablement, open a new INT ticket after SRE signs off on propagation lag alerts for eu-west.
